name: text-box
does: The native Instagram-style text box (the text face 800 at 54 px on the pack's text-box colours, one box per line, centred at TOP): the hook from frame 0, a numbered label on the line that opens each section, the CTA from its cut held to the last frame.
use_when: lo-fi and showcase: the hook (two short lines, frame 0), a chapter label on each audience or step ('1. Start with the hook'), the CTA box on the last cut
inputs: the text (TEXT; \n breaks a line) in sentence case, true, no em dashes
the role (ROLE: hook, label or cta): it sets the approved sounds; a CTA ends at "end"
the window: a hook from 0.0, a label on the first word of its section, a CTA on the cut into the last shot

constants.TEXT:
Most people skip this step.
Here's why it matters.

notes.TEXT: one line per \n; keep each line under about 30 characters at 54 px
notes.TOP: px: the box's top (236 is the kit's place, inside the top safe zone)

needs: STYLE "lofi" or "showcase" (the box is part of the lo-fi type system)

cta (--end end).TEXT:
Part two is on my page.
Follow so you catch it.

typical_length: hook 5 s, label 2.4-2.7 s, cta to the end
